title: Starmap
description: The root of star-systems.json: every star system on the starmap, keyed by the id of its active definition in the catalog (StarSystemDefinition).

modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last changed.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last changed the file.

starSystems.description: Every star system's career state, keyed by the id of its active starSystemDefinitions entry.

name.description: The name, as in the references to the star system.

difficulty.description: The star system's difficulty, as the starmap shows it.

canTravelTo.description: Whether the star system's travel requirements are met; story systems stay locked until then.

travelDays.description: The days the trip from the current star system takes, as the starmap shows them; 0 for the current star system and null where the game finds no route, always while canTravelTo is false.

travelCost.description: The C-Bills the trip costs, under the same rules as travelDays.
